lines.text: The leaders report that Israelites, including priests and Levites, have married daughters of the surrounding peoples and mixed the holy seed.
Ezra tears his tunic and cloak, pulls out hair from his head and beard, and sits in horror while those who tremble gather.
At the morning offering, Ezra falls on his knees, spreads out his hands, and says he is ashamed to lift his face to God.
Ezra says God has extended grace in the sight of the kings of Assyria, giving new life to rebuild the house of God.
Ezra asks whether they will again break God's commandments and intermarry, and he calls the LORD, God of Israel, righteous.
